# Abstract

- **Importance:** population cognitive classification in HRS Core; dementia and MCI surveillance; limited assessment battery
- **Objective:** describe two HRS Core methods calibrated to HRS/HCAP (Core algorithm, PMM); compare with the HRS/HCAP Algorithm, consensus, Langa-Weir, and Hudomiet
- **Design:** 2016 HRS Core classification in HRS/HCAP participants; consensus-panel secondary comparator
  - Study sample: HRS/HCAP 2016 participants, N = `r format(nrow(analysis2_hcap), big.mark = ",")`
  - [Provenance: R/MS_MAIN/MS_001_analysis_cohort.R]
- **Methods:** Core algorithm; PMM
  - Primary comparator: HRS/HCAP Algorithm
  - Secondary comparators: (1) HCAP consensus; (2) Langa-Weir; (3) Hudomiet classification
  - Statistical analysis: dementia versus non-dementia kappa; 3-class quadratic weighted kappa (Normal, MCI, Dementia); all statistics other than frequencies use complex sampling weights 
  - [Provenance: R/MS_MAIN/MS_010_results_objects.R]
- **Results:** 
  - Dementia/non-dementia kappa
    - Core algorithm versus HRS/HCAP Algorithm: `r round(analysis2_a7$summary$algorithmic_hrs_binary_kappa, 3)`
    - PMM versus HRS/HCAP Algorithm: `r round(analysis2_pmm$summary$algorithmic_combined_binary_kappa, 3)`
  - 3-class kappa
    - Core algorithm versus HRS/HCAP Algorithm: `r round(analysis2_a7$summary$algorithmic_hrs_kappa, 3)`
    - PMM versus HRS/HCAP Algorithm: `r round(analysis2_pmm$summary$algorithmic_combined_kappa, 3)`
  - [Provenance: R_objects/A7_100_hcap_tables.rds; R/PMM_110_Comparison_of_Consensus_Langa_Weir.R]
- **Conclusions and relevance:** Two core classification approaches; agreement evidence rather than clinical validation; uncertainty in distinguishing MCI from normal cognition and dementia; limited precision of comparisons with consensus diagnoses because the consensus-panel subsample is small
  - [Provenance: analysis design; inference]

**Key terms**

- **HRS/HCAP Algorithm**: c.f. Manly, Jones et al. (2022)

- **Core algorithm**: HCAP algorithm adapted to the HRS Core data

- **PMM**: Profile mixture model applied to data collected in the HRS Core with prediction calibrated using the HRS/HCAP sample and applied to the core
